description: This file defines a class for rotating images using the GD library in Drupal, including argument validation and handling transparency for GIF images.

classes.name: Rotate
classes.description: Defines a GD2 rotate operation for images in Drupal, handling argument validation, transparency, and execution of the rotation.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Returns the arguments required for the rotate operation, including degrees and background color.

methods.name: validateArguments
methods.description: Validates and processes the input arguments, normalizing degrees and handling background color and transparency for GIF images.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the image rotation using imagerotate, handling transparency for GIFs, and updates the image in the toolkit.
